description: Portable acceptance cases; synthetic examples only. Executable code and owner-specific data remain private.
positive: separate occurrence identity despite shared bytes
idempotent repeat no new index entries
append newer source revision retaining historical version
negative: reject public scope without release gate
reject boolean substituted for byte count
deny spoofed resident role and disabled operation

verification.note: A fixture PASS is not native admission or evidence that the resident host ran. Actual regression counts, file hashes and source locators are private owner-held receipts.
